proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _ s t h
  have h1 := SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges h
  have h2 := SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_sum_degrees_eq_card_edges' h
  refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
  rw [← h1]
  calc ∑ v ∈ s, G.degree v ≤ ∑ _v ∈ s, t.card := Finset.sum_le_sum fun v hv => SimpleGraph.isBipartiteWith_degree_le h hv
    _ = _ := by simp
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s t : Finset V), G.IsBipartiteWith (s : Set V) (t : Set V) → (∑ v ∈ s, G.degree v = G.edgeFinset.card) ∧ (∑ w ∈ t, G.degree w = G.edgeFinset.card) ∧ G.edgeFinset.card ≤ s.card * t.card
